title: Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease Late-Charge Rate for Businesses Holding a Current Kestrel Advantage Balloon Contract
content:
# Relationship Pricing Bulletin — Late-Charge Rate and the Kestrel Advantage Balloon Relationship

**Rule.** For the late charge on a unit's most recent rental invoice month under the Kestrel Commercial Fleet Lease, the late-charge rate is 1.00 percent where the business holds an active Kestrel Advantage Balloon contract with no days past due and the unit's ledger shows no late charge posted within the last 12 whole months, 1.25 percent where it holds such a balloon contract and the unit's ledger shows one or more late charges posted within the last 12 whole months, and the late-charge percentage of the unit's program tier where it holds no active balloon contract with no days past due.

**Records read.** From the Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract records of the business: whether one is active with zero days past due. From the fleet unit's own ledger: the late charges posted on that unit and their posting dates. A late charge falls within the last 12 whole months when fewer than 12 whole months separate its posting date from today, whole months being one fewer where today's day of the month is smaller than the posting's.

## Rate table

| Active Kestrel Advantage Balloon Retail Installment Sale Contract, zero days past due | Late charges on this unit within the last 12 whole months | Late-charge rate |
|---|---|---|
| Yes | none | 1.00 percent |
| Yes | one or more | 1.25 percent |
| No | any | the tier's late-charge percentage |

## Cases (hypothetical)

1. A balloon contract active and current; the unit's last late charge was posted 13 whole months ago: none within the window, 1.00 percent.
2. The same, but a late charge was posted 11 whole months ago on this unit: 1.25 percent.
3. A late charge within the window on a different fleet unit of the business, none on this one: 1.00 percent, since only this unit's ledger is read.
4. The business's balloon contract is active but 3 days past due: the tier's late-charge percentage.
